info.title: Chat Message API
info.description:
Provides methods for sending and retrieving messages within a chat session.
Supports retrieval of chat events and message history from a given point in
time, sending new messages to a chat, and posting message status updates.

region.description: The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The event id to start from

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of events to read forward

get.summary: Retrieves a chat's messages from an point (event) in time and works backwards

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The event id to work backwards from

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of messages to return

200.description: A list of partial and the requested number of complete messages, aggregated from the chat events

requestBody.description: Detail of the message to send
Details of the message status updates

200.description: The status updates were successfully received

earliestEventId.description: The earliest event id that was included in the message aggregation. If this value is above 0, there will be more data available and should be used in the 'from' parameter of subsequent calls

latestEventId.description: The latest event id that was included in the message aggregation.

sentEventId.description: The event id that corresponds to the sent event for the message

metadata.description: Custom metadata relating to the message

statusUpdates.description: Array of updates keyed by the profileId and a list of statues and the date the status was set

MessageComplete.description: Details of a message sent to a chat

MessageEvent.description: An event relating to a message

chatId.description: The id of the chat that the message was sent on

sentOn.description: The date the message was sent in ISO 8601 format

direction.description: Indicates the direction of the message

MessageContext.description: Platform metadata relating to the message

id.description: The id of the profile the message was from

name.description: The name for the profile that sent the message

MessageContextFrom.description: Details of the sender of a message

metadata.description: Custom metadata relating to the message

direction.description: Indicates the direction of the message

isAutomatedSend.description: Indicates if a message was an automated send - will be ommitted from analytics

MessagePost.description: Details of a message to post to the chat

id.description: The globally unique id of the message

eventId.description: The id of the event corresponding to the send in the message stream for this chat

MessagePostResult.description: The id of the message sent event recorded

type.description: The mime type (if applicable) sof the part

url.description: A url associated with the message part

size.description: Size of the message part in bytes

title.description: Title for the notification to send to all platforms. Note that this is ignored if any details are set in platforms

body.description: Body for the notification to send to all platforms. Note that this is ignored if any details are set in platforms

badge.description: The value to display on the application badge

alert.description: The alert to display on the device when the notification arrives

collapse_key.description: The collapse key to send to FCM
